Courses follow the CEFR from A1 to C1, each level lasting 8 weeks on weekdays, and you can take at most two levels per semester; starting from A1 without repeating a level, you reach B2 by the end of the year. You must attend at least 70% of each level's classes, and completing the preparatory programme successfully earns a B2 TÖMER certificate.

Students who want to attend the preparatory class directly do not need to take the proficiency (exemption) exam.
